h1:
Pattaya & Jomtien Beach Clubs, Rooftops & Sea-View Bars
10 Sunset Spots
intro: The Pattaya coastline faces west, which means evenings here come with the sun dropping straight into the bay. From beach clubs with infinity pools to little bars with chairs right on the sand and rooftops high enough to see the whole gulf, we picked 10 spots that are actually open right now — with the area, rough prices, and the right time to arrive so you catch the good light.

blocks.html: Pattaya and Jomtien stretch in a long line along a bay that faces west, so evening is the golden hour for this town. Some people like sitting on the sand with their feet in the water; others want to look down on the whole bay from a tall building. So we split the list into three groups: feet-in-the-sand beach clubs, rooftops on tall buildings, and easygoing beachfront bars. Pick whatever matches the mood that day. Prices are rough figures from recent menus and can change, so double-check at the venue.

This group is for settling in from afternoon till evening — pools, beachfront daybeds, DJs. Most don't charge entry if you're eating or drinking, but if you book a daybed or cabana there's usually a minimum spend.

items.name: Cave Beach Club
items.blurb: A boho-style beach club on Jomtien Beach that's relaxed and easygoing, with the view opening straight out to sea. The sunset angle here is genuinely lovely for the price, and reviewers like that the vibe is more chilled than the big clubs — no need to dress up.
items.meta: Jomtien Beach · free entry · drinks from ฿200

items.name: Alexa Beach Club
items.blurb: A large beach club under the Pinnacle Grand Jomtien with a roughly 600 sqm infinity pool, beachfront daybeds, several bars, and both Thai and international DJs. Good for a lively day-party crowd. Free entry if you sit at the restaurant or bar; daybeds come with a minimum spend.
items.meta: Na Jomtien · free entry · daybed min. spend ฿2,000+

items.name: Fish Club — Andaz Pattaya Jomtien Beach
items.blurb: The beachside bar and seafood grill at the Andaz by Hyatt on Na Jomtien Beach. The draw is grilled seafood with a sunset view, and a DJ comes on after dark. Prices are hotel-level, but you get good food and a quieter setting than the Pattaya city side.
items.meta: Na Jomtien · seafood grill · à la carte high hundreds to low thousands of baht

items.name: Surf & Turf Beach Club
items.blurb: A Mediterranean-style spot right on Wong Amat Beach on the Naklua–North Pattaya side, known for its steaks and a quiet stretch of sand away from the chaos, with live music in the evening. If you want an outdoor table at sunset, book ahead.
items.meta: Wong Amat Beach (Naklua) · steak/Mediterranean · book outdoor tables

blocks.title: Daybed Booking Tip
blocks.html: Big beach clubs like Alexa usually charge a minimum spend per daybed rather than a flat rental fee. If you're a group that plans to eat and drink anyway, you'll hit the minimum easily. If it's just two of you, sitting in the regular restaurant section is better value.

To see the whole Pattaya bay as one long curve, you have to go up. This group is hotel rooftop bars with wider views than the feet-in-the-sand spots. Drinks cost a bit more, but you get an angle the beach clubs can't give you. Most open in the late afternoon and run until late.

items.name: ZAMĀ Skybar — D Varee Jomtien Beach
items.blurb: A rooftop on the 38th floor of D Varee Jomtien that opened in early 2025, one of the highest seaside rooftops in town right now. It looks out over the long sweep of Jomtien–Pattaya bay, plays afro-house, and has a slightly dressed-up crowd. Open from late afternoon till late.

items.name: Horizon Rooftop — Hilton Pattaya
items.blurb: The 34th-floor rooftop at the Hilton Pattaya in the city center, with a panoramic view of Pattaya bay. It's been a steady, reliable choice for years. From 17:00–19:00 the Sunset Session offers buy-one-get-one cocktails, which makes it much better value if you come early.
items.meta: Central Pattaya, 34th floor · Sunset Session 17:00–19:00 · drinks ฿500–850

items.name: Skybar Summer Club
items.blurb: A club-style rooftop on the 27th floor that mixes a party with the sunset — live DJ, shows, and sea views all around. Good for anyone who wants more energy than a quiet hotel rooftop. If you just want to sit and take in the view, it may not be your thing, but if you want something livelier this delivers.
items.meta: Pattaya, 27th floor · DJ + shows · drinks from high hundreds of baht up

blocks.title: Get There in Time for the Light
blocks.html: In the hot season the sun sets around 18:30; in the cool season it shifts earlier to about 18:00. If you want a seat at the edge with the view, arrive at least 45 minutes before sunset, especially at the popular rooftops where balcony tables fill up fast. Come early and you'll also catch the golden hour before the sun drops below the horizon.

Don't want to pay a lot, don't want to dress up, just want to sit and watch the sea with a cold drink — this group is the best fit. Some sit on a hill looking down at the water; others put chairs right on the sand.

items.name: The Sky Gallery Pattaya
items.blurb: A café-restaurant on the Pratamnak hillside. The selling point is terraces that step down the slope with a wide-open view of the sea — a sunset angle that Pattaya locals love bringing visitors to for photos. Around 17:00–18:00 is just right. Cocktails start around ฿265, food runs about ฿900–1,800 per head.

items.name: Beachfront bars on central–south Jomtien Beach
items.blurb: All along Jomtien Beach there are spots with canvas chairs and wooden tables set out on the sand, selling cold beer and snacks at friendly prices. Sit with your feet in the sand and watch the sunset with zero planning — just walk along and pick whichever place you like. Good for a night when you want easy and no fuss.
items.meta: Along Jomtien Beach · beer/snacks at friendly prices · walk and pick a spot

items.name: Beachfront bars on south Pattaya–Pratamnak
items.blurb: The south Pattaya into Pratamnak stretch has bars along the beach road facing the sea, where you can sip a drink and watch the boats and city lights in the evening. Good if you're staying around central–south Pattaya and don't want to travel far, though it gets crowded in high season, so leave extra time to find a seat.
items.meta: South Pattaya–Pratamnak · along the beach road · crowded in high season

blocks.text: Which One to Pick by Style

items: Want to lounge in the pool all afternoon — Alexa Beach Club or Cave Beach Club in Jomtien, feet in the sand and chill.
Want a bay view from up high — Horizon at the Hilton (come for the Sunset Session for the best value) or ZAMĀ on the 38th floor in Jomtien.
Want great photos without spending much — The Sky Gallery on Pratamnak Hill; go before 6pm.
On a budget and don't want to plan — the beachfront bars on Jomtien Beach; just sit on the sand with a cold beer.

faq.q: When is the best time to watch the sunset in Pattaya?
faq.a: Pattaya and Jomtien beaches face west, so you can see the sun set straight over the sea. In the hot season it sets around 18:30, in the cool season around 18:00. Arrive at least 45 minutes early to grab a seat by the view and catch the golden hour before the sun drops below the horizon.

faq.q: Do Pattaya beach clubs charge an entry fee?
faq.a: Most, like Cave Beach Club and Alexa, don't charge entry if you sit at the restaurant or have a drink at the bar. But if you book a daybed or cabana there's usually a minimum spend per daybed — Alexa, for example, starts around ฿2,000 and up. Check with the venue as it can change.

faq.q: Rooftop or beach club — which should I choose?
faq.a: If you want your feet in the sand, a pool, and a relaxed vibe, go for a beach club in Jomtien. If you want to see the whole bay as a curve from up high and don't mind higher drink prices, pick a rooftop like Horizon or ZAMĀ.

faq.q: What's the highest rooftop in Pattaya right now?
faq.a: ZAMĀ Skybar on the 38th floor of D Varee Jomtien Beach is one of the highest seaside rooftops in Pattaya–Jomtien right now. It's open roughly 16:00–03:00, with drinks around ฿500–850.

faq.q: Can I watch the sunset on a tight budget?
faq.a: Absolutely. Walk along Jomtien Beach and you'll find spots with chairs set out on the sand selling cold beer and snacks at friendly prices. Sit with your feet in the sand and watch the sunset — no booking and no dress code required. It's the easiest option on the wallet.
